{{Quote|Poor little fool chose oblivion over a future.|Queen Miraj Scintel|<ref name="The Clone Wars 3">[[The Clone Wars 3|''The Clone Wars'' 3]]</ref>}}
A '''girl''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She attempted to assassinate the queen, but was stopped by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was posing as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lars Quell]]. After the queen told her that she would be sent to reprocessing, the girl broke free of Anakin's grasp and committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by jumping from the balcony.<ref name="SOTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In her [[The Clone Wars 3|original appearance]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''The Clone Wars'' comics]], the girl was originally a blonde [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="TCW3">[[The Clone Wars 3|''The Clone Wars'' 3]]</ref> For the episode "[[Slaves of the Republic]]" in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series, she was reimagined as a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]];<ref name="SOTR" /> otherwise her story is identical to her comic appearance.
